n2e834e91eb.why: The hryvnia is Ukraine's currency, and its exchange rate against the dollar affects import costs, inflation and foreign-currency pricing.

nbfcefbd19d.summary: Poland has moved up to sixth place among EU economies. Its GDP is more than twice the size of Romania's and is growing faster.
nbfcefbd19d.why: Poland is the largest economy in Central and Eastern Europe, and its growth rank affects EU funding, investment flows and the zloty.

n4fdeb1193b.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif ordered accelerated enforcement measures to meet tax targets. He said the faceless system for Inland Revenue must be fully rolled out by 2027.
n4fdeb1193b.why: Tax collection targets underpin Pakistan's fiscal position and its commitments to international lenders, making revenue measures important for the economy and sovereign credit.

n8d5e7374c2.summary: Cabinet approval for deregulating oil prices is expected soon, according to Minister Ahad Chima. A Gunvor Group delegation met the Minister of Economic Affairs and expressed interest in upgrading its refineries.
n8d5e7374c2.why: Oil price deregulation changes how fuel prices are set in Pakistan, affecting inflation and fuel importers. Gunvor is a major global commodities trader and refiner.

n67d4087694.summary: Everlight Electronics has broken ground on a new plant in Thailand, intended as a key hub of its global supply chain. The facility targets AI server and automotive markets.
n67d4087694.why: Everlight is a Taiwan-based maker of optoelectronic semiconductors such as LEDs and sensors, which feed consumer, automotive and data-center electronics.

nb9256d6443.headline: Warehouse halls to rise in Žatec, employing 300 people
nb9256d6443.summary: A nine-hectare warehouse complex with two halls is planned near Velichov, close to Žatec. The project would employ 300 people in three-shift operation with daily traffic of 200 cars and 120 trucks.
nb9256d6443.why: Logistics and warehouse investment reflects demand for distribution space and related regional employment in the Czech Republic.

n325051e58d.headline: Rwanda: New Bugesera Road Cuts Freight Time, Opens Up Trade Opportunities
n325051e58d.summary: A rehabilitated road linking Bugesera to Ngoma and Nyanza is opening a shorter route for freight trucks. It helps trucks avoid Kigali congestion on the Tanzania-Rwanda corridor.
n325051e58d.why: Freight corridors between East African neighbours affect transport costs and the flow of trade in goods.

ncf52e6429b.headline: Labor budget's big bank blow as loan applications drop
ncf52e6429b.summary: Federal Labor's changes to capital gains tax concessions and negative gearing appear to have prompted a decline in loan applications. The report cites banks as affected.
ncf52e6429b.why: Capital gains tax and negative gearing rules influence investor property borrowing, a major source of lending for Australian banks.

nefbb255c6e.headline: M&A momentum builds despite higher rates and tax headwinds
nefbb255c6e.summary: The proposed merger of Bank Australia and P&N Group is cited as the latest example of M&A momentum, despite higher rates and tax headwinds.
nefbb255c6e.why: Bank mergers reshape the competitive structure of Australia's mid-tier lending market and affect deal activity across financials.

nec98e68ca4.headline: Coupang’s (CPNG) Sales Keep Climbing While Its Profits Take A Hit
nec98e68ca4.summary: Coupang reported quarterly net revenues up 4% year over year to $8.9 billion, or 10% in constant currency. The company swung to an operating loss of $556 million from a prior-year profit.
nec98e68ca4.why: Coupang is an e-commerce and delivery company whose main operations are in South Korea. Its results indicate growth and profitability trends for investors in online retail.

n3ab07654a1.headline: Dollar gains, yen weakens as markets eye US CPI
n3ab07654a1.summary: The US dollar rose and the yen weakened on Monday as oil prices increased ahead of Wednesday's US consumer price index release.
n3ab07654a1.why: The dollar is the world's main reserve currency, and US inflation data shapes expectations for Federal Reserve policy and global currency flows.
n3ab07654a1.why_moved: Higher oil prices and anticipation of US inflation data drove currency moves as traders positioned for the CPI release.

n9f24c18128.headline: Oil prices climb as Iranian demands cloud outlook for Strait of Hormuz
n9f24c18128.summary: Brent crude rose as Tehran said the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen without major US concessions. The waterway's status remains a key uncertainty for oil supply.
n9f24c18128.why: Brent is the main global crude benchmark, and the Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil trade, so disruptions there move energy prices worldwide.
n9f24c18128.why_moved: Iran said the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen without major US concessions, raising the risk of prolonged disruption to oil flows.

ne5de8c1429.headline: Oil rises as Iran-Oman Hormuz deal nears but reopening remains uncertain
ne5de8c1429.summary: Oil prices rose on Monday as uncertainty persisted over Gulf peace talks. Talks over an Iran-Oman arrangement for the Strait of Hormuz were nearing a deal, but reopening remained unclear.
ne5de8c1429.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne crude and LNG trade, so disruptions there quickly affect global oil prices. Brent is the main global crude benchmark.
ne5de8c1429.why_moved: Oil rose as uncertainty over Gulf peace talks and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz persisted.

nb9c385db84.headline: Labor budget's big bank blow as loan applications drop
nb9c385db84.summary: Federal Labor changes to capital gains tax concessions and negative gearing appear to have prompted a decline in loan applications, according to a report on big bank activity.
nb9c385db84.why: Capital gains tax and negative gearing rules shape investor property lending, a major source of mortgage demand for Australian banks. Changes can affect bank loan volumes and housing credit.

n4c8f6cf70a.headline: West Asia Conflict: Hormuz reopening talks hit deadlock
n4c8f6cf70a.summary: Talks between Iran and Oman on reopening the Strait of Hormuz have reached a stalemate, as Tehran imposes additional conditions. The US insists on the deal.
n4c8f6cf70a.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major chokepoint for global oil shipments, so its status drives energy prices and shipping costs.

nfac9b7ef09.headline: Trump Says U.S. is ‘Semi-Negotiating’ with Iran, Will Let Economic Pressure Mount
nfac9b7ef09.summary: With the Strait of Hormuz still closed and oil prices rising, President Donald Trump said the US has shifted strategy toward applying economic pressure on Iran while semi-negotiating.
nfac9b7ef09.why: Strait of Hormuz disruptions and US-Iran tensions directly affect global crude supply and prices.
nfac9b7ef09.why_moved: The Strait of Hormuz remains closed and oil prices are rising, which increases concern over supply and economic costs.

n4f6db521e2.headline: GEL Q2 Deep Dive: Balance Sheet Progress and Offshore Asset Strategy Drive Results
n4f6db521e2.summary: Midstream energy company Genesis Energy reported Q2 2026 revenue up 41% year on year to $532 million, beating Wall Street estimates. GAAP earnings of $0.26 per share were above consensus.
n4f6db521e2.why: Genesis Energy is a US midstream company moving and storing oil and gas, and its results reflect demand and pricing across pipeline infrastructure.

nb6fb57f075.headline: Oil prices fluctuate amid uncertainty over possible reopening of the Strait of Hormuz
nb6fb57f075.summary: Crude oil prices showed little movement on August 10 after erasing earlier gains. Optimism over negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz was offset by Iran's position that US demands must be met first.
nb6fb57f075.why: Brent and WTI are the benchmark crude grades, and the Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so any disruption there feeds directly into global energy prices.
nb6fb57f075.why_moved: Negotiations over reopening the Strait of Hormuz were presented as uncertain, with Iran setting conditions, which left crude prices without a clear direction after an earlier rally was erased.

n7a5c456100.summary: Vietnam's BIDV is launching a preferential interest rate lending program of up to VND 50,000 billion, applied across its entire system. The aim is to support growth drivers and small and medium-sized enterprises.
n7a5c456100.why: BIDV is one of Vietnam's largest state-controlled commercial banks, so its lending programs shape credit conditions for businesses and the broader economy.

n56bbae8209.why: Vinpearl is a Vietnamese resort and hotel operator within the Vingroup group, and brand strength supports its tourism and hospitality business.

n68958cb2ca.summary: The State Bank of Vietnam issued an official letter to commercial banks on a credit programme for growth drivers and SMEs. The proposed preferential lending rate is 1% a year lower than the average lending rate.
n68958cb2ca.why: The State Bank of Vietnam sets monetary policy and credit conditions, which influence bank lending, SME financing and economic growth.

ne977021ded.summary: The Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation said 261 more foreign investors were granted securities trading code numbers in July 2026.
ne977021ded.why: Trading codes allow foreign investors to access Vietnam's securities markets. Growth in foreign participation is a gauge of market access and investor interest.

n4d4883fa1e.summary: Shares of Hoa Binh Securities (HBS) remain under a trading restriction from 12 August. They may only be traded on the sixth session of each week.
n4d4883fa1e.why: Hoa Binh Securities is a Vietnamese brokerage. Trading restrictions limit liquidity and affect investors holding the stock.

nd01755e400.headline: CDB, CAF contribute US$1 million to Venezuela recovery
nd01755e400.summary: The Caribbean Development Bank and CAF each provided US$1 million toward Venezuela's recovery and reconstruction after back-to-back earthquakes that killed several people.
nd01755e400.why: Development banks such as CAF and CDB fund reconstruction and infrastructure projects that shape recovery prospects in the region.

n9a5fa7e94b.headline: Hévíz-Balaton Airport to Receive Substantial State Support
n9a5fa7e94b.summary: Hévíz-Balaton Airport in Sármellék will receive 1.2 billion forints (about 3.31 million euros) in state subsidies for operations this year. The government separately announced 5.5 billion forints for the wider airport network.
n9a5fa7e94b.why: Regional airports depend on state support for operating costs, and subsidy decisions shape their finances and connectivity.

n03d1325fa3.headline: S&P 500 hits record high as Iran nuclear deal stalls
n03d1325fa3.summary: U.S. stock futures edged higher on Monday and the S&P 500 reached a record high, while an Iran nuclear deal stalled.
n03d1325fa3.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US listed companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance.

n13924741da.headline: Diana Shipping Inc. and Star Bulk Carriers Announce Mutual Agreement to Terminate Vessel Sale and Purchase Agreement
n13924741da.summary: Diana Shipping and Star Bulk Carriers agreed to terminate a vessel sale and purchase agreement. Diana's offer to acquire all outstanding shares of Genco remains on the table.
n13924741da.why: Diana Shipping is a Greek dry bulk shipping company, and its pending offer for Genco is an active takeover situation.

n0eb0570b35.headline: Dabur gets stay order on FSSAI directive from India court
n0eb0570b35.summary: An Indian court granted a stay on a Food Safety and Standards Authority of India directive targeting claims on Dabur product labels, which the regulator called ambiguous and misleading.
n0eb0570b35.why: Dabur is a large Indian consumer goods maker, and labelling rulings affect how its products can be marketed.

nb2e0f12b82.headline: Trump Demands Iran Pay Damages As Strait Of Hormuz Standoff Holds
nb2e0f12b82.summary: Trump said Iran must pay reparations for decades of violence, as both sides set new demands in stalled talks over reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Iran wants sanctions lifted and compensation first.
nb2e0f12b82.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so any disruption to its reopening directly affects global crude supply and prices.

n12da957703.headline: Iran Ties Hormuz Reopening to US Concessions on Several Demands
n12da957703.summary: Iran said it was nearing a final pact with Oman on new shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz. It said the US must meet other conditions, including compensation and an end to sanctions and military threats, before reopening the waterway.
n12da957703.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major oil and LNG transit route, so its reopening status directly affects global energy supply.

n89c89c2106.headline: Trump Demands Iran Pay Damages As Strait Of Hormuz Standoff Holds
n89c89c2106.summary: Donald Trump said Iran must pay reparations for decades of violence as both sides set new demands in stalled talks over reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Iran wants sanctions lifted and war damages compensated first.
n89c89c2106.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruption there affects energy prices and shipping costs.

na76517a531.headline: ‘Compulsive addiction to sanctions’: Iran mocks Trump admin's ‘suffocating’ threat
na76517a531.summary: Iran mocked the Trump administration's reliance on economic sanctions, warning that repeated attempts to squeeze Tehran could leave Washington with fewer options to end the crisis.
na76517a531.why: Sanctions on Iran restrict its oil exports and financial access, which influences global crude supply and sanctioned-asset risk.

n60a5531472.headline: RBA set to hold rates today, but markets will be watching the fine print
n60a5531472.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia is widely expected to hold rates today, with focus on whether any board members dissent in favour of a hike and the Governor's tone on tightening.
n60a5531472.why: The RBA sets Australia's cash rate, which drives borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and bank earnings.

ne40815a75e.headline: Iran war adds pressure to slowing U.S. economy
ne40815a75e.summary: The war with Iran, now over five months old with no end in sight, is acting as a tax on the US economy. Energy costs are rising, inflation has accelerated, and military spending is running into tens of billions of dollars.
ne40815a75e.why: The US economy is the world's largest and its inflation and rate path shape global asset prices, so an energy-driven inflation shock matters widely for investors.

n5b90132c48.headline: Trump Demands Iran Pay Damages As Strait Of Hormuz Standoff Holds
n5b90132c48.summary: Trump says Iran must pay reparations, as both sides set new demands in stalled talks over reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Iran wants sanctions lifted and war damages compensated first.
n5b90132c48.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key oil transit route, so negotiations over its reopening affect global energy supply and prices.

n83fc9db35f.headline: Preview: RBA to stay in pause and observe mode, TD Securities says ahead of today's decision
n83fc9db35f.summary: TD Securities expects the Reserve Bank of Australia to hold its cash rate at 4.35% today. Markets price near-zero odds of a hike after a softer Q2 trimmed mean CPI print.
n83fc9db35f.why: The RBA sets Australia's cash rate, which anchors borrowing costs and the Australian dollar.

n5be41f3d2d.headline: Customs duty on gold, silver, platinum tops Rs 10,460 crore since duty hike
n5be41f3d2d.summary: India collected Rs 10,463 crore in customs duty on gold, silver and platinum imports between May 13 and August 2, following a duty increase. The figure reflects the period after the hike.
n5be41f3d2d.why: India is one of the world's largest bullion importers, and import duties on precious metals affect domestic prices and trade flows. Changes in duty influence gold demand and smuggling incentives.

n70e543e25e.headline: PM Expresses Satisfaction Over $3.6 Billion Remittances in July
n70e543e25e.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif expressed satisfaction over $3.6 billion in remittances sent by overseas Pakistanis in July. The figure was reported by Radio Pakistan.
n70e543e25e.why: Remittances are a major source of foreign-currency inflows for Pakistan and support its external balance.

n7b9d111f8b.headline: CAG report flags decline in Delhi’s contribution to national GDP
n7b9d111f8b.summary: Delhi's share of the national economy declined over the past decade even as its GSDP grew 9.17% in 2024-25. The CAG flagged falling capital expenditure and low asset-creation allocations by local bodies.
n7b9d111f8b.why: Gross state domestic product measures a state's economic output, and the CAG is India's auditor general. Shifts in regional economic shares inform fiscal and investment policy.

n58f74f1413.headline: China Retaliates Against UFLPA Entity List Additions, Restricts Trade With 6 Textile-related Firms
n58f74f1413.summary: China has told Chinese businesses not to conduct business or cooperate with six textile and apparel companies and nonprofits. The move responds to additions to the UFLPA Entity List.
n58f74f1413.why: The UFLPA Entity List restricts imports into the US of goods linked to forced labor in Xinjiang, so new listings affect apparel supply chains and US-China trade relations.

n0ede6876f1.headline: Realion tips 2026 investment sales at $45b to $50b
n0ede6876f1.summary: Realion expects investment sales in Singapore's property market to reach $45 billion to $50 billion in 2026, barring major macroeconomic shocks.
n0ede6876f1.why: Investment sales volumes indicate capital flows into commercial and residential real estate, a key segment of Singapore's economy and financial sector.

nbeb0ff0cea.headline: STI banks hit record income as wealth and treasury fees surge
nbeb0ff0cea.summary: Singapore's largest banks recorded record income as wealth and treasury fees surged. Their combined index weight now accounts for around 20% of the FTSE ASEAN All-Share Index, up from about 9% at end-2019.
nbeb0ff0cea.why: Singapore's major banks are the largest constituents of the region's benchmark index, so their earnings strongly influence Southeast Asian equity performance.

n8fef18a598.headline: BSP urges banks to manage risks as AI use expands
n8fef18a598.summary: BSP Governor Eli Remolona Jr. said AI could help financial institutions analyze information, but decisions on its use must remain with people. He urged banks to manage the associated risks.
n8fef18a598.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the Philippines' central bank and banking regulator, so its guidance shapes how local lenders adopt new technology.

n4a0b13c48b.headline: Vietnam stock market recovery continues, key resistance looms at 1,780 points
n4a0b13c48b.summary: The VN-Index rose for a second straight week on improving liquidity and capital flows. Analysts say the market faces a critical test near the 1,780-point resistance level.
n4a0b13c48b.why: The VN-Index tracks the Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange, a key benchmark for Vietnamese equities.

nef6d612e0d.headline: GS E&C, LS Electric team up on AI data center power systems
nef6d612e0d.summary: GS Engineering & Construction said it is teaming up with LS Electric to strengthen power infrastructure for its artificial intelligence data center projects.
nef6d612e0d.why: GS E&C is a South Korean construction group, and LS Electric supplies power equipment used in data centers.

n47459c5135.headline: Globe profit shrinks 11% to P11 billion
n47459c5135.summary: Globe Telecom's profit shrank 11% to P11 billion. The company expects to return to growth in the second half, relying on core products and new services.
n47459c5135.why: Globe is one of the Philippines' two largest telecom operators, and its earnings reflect the country's mobile and broadband market.

n71ef2b2c3e.headline: SM Prime earnings steady in 6 months
n71ef2b2c3e.summary: SM Prime Holdings' earnings remained steady in the first half, despite challenging market conditions. The company is one of the Philippines' largest property developers.
n71ef2b2c3e.why: SM Prime is a major Philippine property developer and mall operator, so its earnings are a read on domestic real estate and consumer demand.

na626b8c4fb.headline: ALI infusing P20 billion mall, hotel assets to AREIT
na626b8c4fb.summary: Ayala Land is infusing P20 billion worth of mall and hotel assets into AREIT, expanding the REIT's assets under management to P179 billion.
na626b8c4fb.why: Ayala Land is a major Philippine property developer, and REIT asset injections are a common way to transfer income-producing property into listed vehicles.

nc7ca5dafe6.headline: Maharashtra FDA Suspends Blinkit Commerce Food Licence Over Cockroach Infestation, Hygiene Lapses In Malad
nc7ca5dafe6.summary: The Maharashtra FDA suspended Blinkit Commerce's food licence in Malad after an inspection found hygiene violations, including a cockroach infestation and expired products.
nc7ca5dafe6.why: Blinkit is a quick-commerce grocery delivery platform owned by Eternal, and regulatory licence actions affect its operations in India.

n5956d02849.headline: Ringgit to trade range-bound vs US dollar this week
n5956d02849.summary: The ringgit is expected to stay range-bound against the US dollar this week, trading between RM4.07 and RM4.09. Investors remain cautious about the direction of US interest rates, an analyst says.
n5956d02849.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves against the dollar affect the cost of imports and the returns on ringgit assets for foreign investors.

n5786f179a3.headline: Ex-US Defense Chief Warns China Could Gain if CLARITY Act Fails
n5786f179a3.summary: Former US Defense Secretary Mark Esper urged senators to pass the CLARITY Act. He warned that China and North Korea could benefit if US crypto rules remain unclear.
n5786f179a3.why: The CLARITY Act would set the US regulatory framework for crypto assets, which determines how digital asset firms can operate and compete.

n77e1e311c0.headline: BIP-110 Ends With a Whimper, CLARITY Vote Punted: Hodler’s Digest, Aug. 9
n77e1e311c0.summary: Cointelegraph's weekly digest says BIP-110 is considered dead and the CLARITY Act is heading for a final Senate showdown on September 15. The vote was reportedly punted.
n77e1e311c0.why: The CLARITY Act is proposed US crypto market legislation, and Senate decisions shape regulatory clarity for digital asset firms.

nf2c7acc282.headline: Ringgit opens higher against US$
nf2c7acc282.summary: The ringgit opened higher against the US dollar on Monday after weaker United States non-farm payrolls data, according to The Star.
nf2c7acc282.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves against the dollar reflect shifts in US rate expectations and regional capital flows.

nc61c2d9886.headline: FBM KLCI little changed in early trade amid dearth of new catalysts
nc61c2d9886.summary: The FBM KLCI was flat at the opening bell in Kuala Lumpur as traders looked for direction amid a lack of new catalysts.
nc61c2d9886.why: The FBM KLCI is Malaysia's benchmark index of the largest companies listed on Bursa Malaysia.

n75aee42c99.headline: Analysis-BOJ
n75aee42c99.summary: The Bank of Japan may be edging toward an early rate hike, Reuters reported, but faces a growing risk that political pressure will offset any tightening. The analysis is dated August 10.
n75aee42c99.why: The Bank of Japan sets monetary policy for Japan, and its rate path influences the yen, Japanese government bond yields and global carry trades.

ncdbdc35876.headline: Aflac US sales grow amid climbing voluntary benefits claims costs
ncdbdc35876.summary: Aflac's US sales grew while costs of voluntary benefits claims rose. More employees are filing supplemental claims as employers shift health costs onto workers.
ncdbdc35876.why: Aflac is a US-based insurer that specialises in supplemental and voluntary benefits sold through employers. Its claims trends are a key indicator of its profitability in that segment.

impacts.why: US sales growth is offset by rising claims costs in voluntary benefits, which pressures the insurer's margins in that line.

n4ec1d214c0.headline: Battery Revolution: In 2 Years, Bulgaria Surprised Everyone in Europe; State Inaction Turned Out to Be an Advantage
n4ec1d214c0.summary: Bulgaria has become one of the fastest-growing markets for industrial batteries in Europe within two years. Batteries are no longer used only to store cheap energy.
